Closing date: Sunday 8th November
Industry: Education and Software, with a focus on medical and health professional education.
Why this role exists
Our customers rely on the risr/ platform to deliver high-stakes and workplace-based assessments that really matter to institutions, professionals, and ultimately patient care.
Events are one of the main ways we meet leads and key decision-makers at organisations we want to work with, and stay close to the customers we have. In 2026, that means around 25 conferences and exhibitions across the UK, Europe, North America, and Australia; our own community days and customer events in each region; and a regular programme of webinars and user groups. You’ll book the space, manage the suppliers, meet every exhibitor deadline, get the right people and materials to the right place, and report back on each event's costs and outcomes.
Most of the work is done remotely from the UK. You’ll attend some UK events in person, and occasionally travel overseas, to see how our events run on the ground and to understand the market and our competitors.
